kind: Prespecified confirmation: race-based static-ish evaluator (z=3) vs no-PAT static
player_a: adjusted: argmax(static_eq + 1.4*blocking_delta + 0.75*setup_delta) over top 60 static placements + up to 5 exchanges within 35 points; 64 sampled racks; candidates raced with blocking_setup_checker_choose z=3, batches of 8 racks (elimination from 8 racks); static when bag empty
pair_design: two games per pair on one seed, same tiles per seat, seats swapped; starting player alternates by pair
seed_note: fresh; pilot used 20261301; the stopped exact-mode run used 20261401 and is not analyzed
primary_outcome: player a score per game (win 1, tie 0.5, loss 0), averaged within pair
primary_test: two-sided z test of mean pair score vs 0.5 using pair-level SE, alpha 0.05; all pairs included
secondary: mean spread; per-decision check/total time distributions (8 workers; machine had ~1 core of OS background load at launch); changed-decision rate by bag/lead stratum (descriptive)
policy_note: z=3 is not identical to the pilot's exact policy: on 360 positions it chose the full-evaluation move 99.4% of the time
not_claimed: equal-time strength vs simulation; other lexica; the exact (z=0) policy
